# Dial Arts

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/dial_impact.png){ .entry-page-icon }

[Schools](index.md) · [Haki Realm](../../hakirework.md)

The school master and lesson requirements govern when these techniques unlock. Haki or fighting-style damage scaling applies when the attack uses that category.

[See combat stats](../../../../characters/combat-stats.md).

!!! note "Reading the stats"
    Listed base damage is for the named part of the move. Pack and Doriki multipliers are shown separately. Times assume 20 ticks per second.


<!-- move hakirework:dial_impact -->

## Impact

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/dial_impact.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Dial Arts. The user holds up an Impact Dial: for two seconds every blow that lands is taken into the shell instead, then let out at once on the one in front. The shock jars the user's arm a little. Needs an Impact Dial carried.


<!-- move hakirework:dial_flash -->

## Flash Dial

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/dial_flash.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Dial Arts. A blinding flash of stored light: everyone around who can see the user is blinded and slowed, and loses sight of them. Needs a Flash Dial carried.


<!-- move hakirework:burn_bazooka -->

## Burn Bazooka

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/burn_bazooka.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Dial Arts. Wyper's: a Flame Dial's fire blown out in a roaring blast that burns everyone ahead and throws them back; the recoil pushes the user back too. Needs a Flame Dial carried.


<!-- move hakirework:dial_reject -->

## Reject

![](../../../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/dial_reject.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

Dial Arts. A Reject Dial takes blows in like Impact, then is pressed to the one in front and lets out ten times as much, with a great blow of its own. The user pays: a quarter of their health and more (half that with Armament up), never the last of it. Needs a Reject Dial carried.
